messages.app.name: Wasel
messages.app.tagline: A fast, beautiful, open-source download manager.
messages.sidebar.label: Library
messages.speed.limitToggle: Turn the speed limit on or off
messages.sort.title: Sort By
messages.sort.name: Name
messages.list.label: Downloads
messages.inspector.title: Info
messages.inspector.empty: Select a download to see its details.
messages.empty.tipBrowser: Install the browser extension to catch downloads automatically
messages.empty.tipDrop: Drag any link and drop it here
messages.empty.tipPaste: Press Ctrl+V anywhere to add a copied link
messages.empty.all.title: No downloads yet
messages.empty.all.body: Paste a link, drop one here, or send it from your browser. Wasel splits files across many connections for maximum speed.
messages.empty.active.title: Nothing is downloading
messages.empty.active.body: Active downloads appear here with live speed and progress.
messages.empty.queued.title: The queue is empty
messages.empty.queued.body: Paused and waiting downloads appear here.
messages.empty.completed.title: No finished downloads
messages.empty.completed.body: Files you download will be listed here.
messages.empty.failed.title: No problems
messages.empty.failed.body: Downloads that could not finish appear here so you can retry them.
messages.empty.category.title: Nothing here yet
messages.empty.category.body: Downloads of this kind will be grouped here automatically.
messages.empty.search.title: No results
messages.add.title: New Download
messages.add.subtitle: Paste one or more links, one per line.
messages.add.batchHint: Tip: use [1-20] to add a numbered series of files.
messages.add.fromBrowserSession: Sent from your browser — your sign-in session is included
messages.settings.title: Settings
messages.settings.startWithWindowsHint: Starts hidden in the tray, ready to catch downloads.
messages.settings.categoryFolders: Sort files into folders by kind
messages.settings.connectionsHint: Large files are split dynamically so every connection stays busy to the last byte.
messages.settings.retriesHint: When the connection drops, Wasel resumes where it stopped.
messages.settings.speedLimitHint: Applies to all downloads together so browsing stays smooth.
messages.settings.userAgentHint: Some sites refuse unknown apps, so Wasel identifies as a modern browser.
messages.settings.askBeforeCaptureHint: Turn off to start downloads from the browser immediately.
messages.settings.clipboardHint: Show a notification when you copy a link to a downloadable file.
messages.extension.chromium2: Turn on “Developer mode” at the top of the page.
messages.extension.chromium3: Click “Load unpacked” and choose this folder:
messages.extension.firefox2: Click “Load Temporary Add-on” and choose manifest.json inside this folder:
messages.extension.note: The extension sends the link, its cookies and the referring page only to Wasel on this computer, so downloads that need you to be signed in work too.
messages.schedule.stopHint: Leave empty to keep going until the end.
messages.schedule.note: The schedule runs while Wasel is in the tray. Turn on “Open at login” to keep it always active.
messages.updates.autoHint: The update installs when Wasel restarts.
messages.updates.readyHint: Restart Wasel to finish updating. Your downloads will resume.
messages.updates.dev: Updates are available in the installed app
messages.updates.error.no-metadata: The latest release has no update information yet. Try again later.
messages.updates.error.rate-limited: GitHub is busy right now. Try again in a few minutes.
messages.updates.error.corrupt: The downloaded update was damaged and was discarded.
messages.updates.error.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again later.
messages.about.legal: Free and open source. Fonts: Inter and IBM Plex Sans Arabic under the SIL Open Font License.
messages.drop.title: Drop links to download
messages.remove.title: Remove “{name}”?
messages.remove.message: Unfinished parts are deleted. Completed files stay on your disk unless you choose otherwise.
messages.clear.title: Clear completed downloads?
messages.clear.message: They are removed from the list only — the files stay on your disk.
messages.bridge.unavailable: The browser bridge could not start. Links can still be sent with the wasel:// handler.
messages.notice.badLink: The link received from the browser is not valid.
messages.error.not-playlist: The stream link did not return a valid playlist.
messages.error.hls-encrypted: This stream uses DRM protection and cannot be downloaded.
messages.error.http-400: The server rejected the request (400). Check the link or whether it has expired.
messages.error.http-408: The server timed out waiting for the request (408). Try again later.
messages.error.http-401: Sign-in required (401). Send the link from the browser extension so your session is included.
messages.error.http-403: Access denied (403). The site may need your browser session — send the link from the extension.
messages.error.http-404: File not found on the server (404).
messages.error.http-410: This link has expired (410). Get a fresh link from the site.
messages.error.http-416: The server rejected the resume request (416). Download it again.
messages.error.http-429: The server is limiting requests (429). Try again shortly.
messages.error.http-5xx: The server is having trouble ({status}). Try again later.
messages.error.html-response: {host} returned a web page instead of the file — the link may have expired or require signing in.
messages.error.permission: No permission to write to “{path}”. Choose another folder.
messages.error.dns: Couldn’t find the server {host}. Check your internet connection.
messages.error.invalid-url: This is not a valid link.
messages.error.unsupported-protocol: Only HTTP and HTTPS links are supported.
messages.error.bad-redirect: The server redirected to an unsupported address.
messages.error.too-many-redirects: The link redirects too many times.
messages.error.bad-range: The server sent an unexpected part of the file.
messages.error.not-directory: The save location is not a folder: {path}
messages.error.invalid-checksum: The checksum must be an MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 or SHA-512 hex value.
messages.error.not-completed: The file has not finished downloading.
messages.error.import-empty: No links were found in that file.
messages.error.startup-unsupported: Opening at login is available on Windows only.
messages.error.startup-dev: Install Wasel to enable opening at login.
messages.main.trayHint.title: Wasel is still running
messages.main.trayHint.body: Downloads continue in the background. Click the tray icon to reopen Wasel.
messages.main.notify.checksumMismatch: Warning: the checksum does not match.
messages.main.notify.shutdownBody: All downloads finished. Click to cancel the shutdown.
messages.main.notify.updateReadyBody: Version {version} installs when you restart Wasel.
messages.main.export.title: Export Download List
messages.main.import.title: Import Download List
messages.turbo.toggle: Turbo: download at the full speed of your connection
messages.turbo.label: Turbo
messages.settings.turboHint: 32 connections per file and no speed limit, to use the full speed of your internet connection.
messages.toast.turboOn: Turbo on — downloading at full speed
messages.add.pageEmpty: This is a web page with no downloadable files. Wasel will save the page itself.
